# Abyss

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abyss)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abyss)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abyss)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abyss)

Abyss is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abyss codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `abyss` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { abyss } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-abyss';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, abyss],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `abyss` | `Extension` |
| `abyssMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#000c18` |
| Active line | `#00122b` |
| Selection | `#032d4a` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.55:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#47c1ff` | bold | 9.70:1 | 9.22:1 | 7.00:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#47c1ff` | bold | 9.70:1 | 9.22:1 | 7.00:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#78b6ff` | - | 9.32:1 | 8.86:1 | 6.72:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#8da0bf` | - | 7.42:1 | 7.06:1 | 5.35:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#7ab2ff` | - | 9.04:1 | 8.60:1 | 6.52:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#c3a2f7` | - | 9.22:1 | 8.77:1 | 6.65:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#c3a2f7` | - | 9.22:1 | 8.77:1 | 6.65:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#8eb8ff` | - | 9.81:1 | 9.32:1 | 7.07:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#b4a2f7` | - | 8.87:1 | 8.43:1 | 6.39:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#ffd47b` | italic | 14.03:1 | 13.34:1 | 10.12:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#ff9eea` | italic | 10.63:1 | 10.10:1 | 7.67:1 |
| String | `string` | `#4ce660` | - | 12.01:1 | 11.41:1 | 8.66:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#4ce660` | - | 12.01:1 | 11.41:1 | 8.66:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#ff9eea` | - | 10.63:1 | 10.10:1 | 7.67:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#ff9e64` | - | 9.69:1 | 9.21:1 | 6.99:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#7ab2ff` | - | 9.04:1 | 8.60:1 | 6.52:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#7599c2` | italic | 6.65:1 | 6.32:1 | 4.80:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#7599c2` | - | 6.65:1 | 6.32:1 | 4.80:1 |
| Tag | `tagName` | `#59d6ff` | - | 11.72:1 | 11.14:1 | 8.45:1 |
| Attribute | `attributeName` | `#ffd580` | - | 14.15:1 | 13.45:1 | 10.20:1 |
| Heading | `heading` | `#8eb8ff` | bold | 9.81:1 | 9.32:1 | 7.07:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | inherits `#a3c9e9` | italic | 11.34:1 | 10.78:1 | 8.18:1 |
| Strong | `strong` | inherits `#a3c9e9` | bold | 11.34:1 | 10.78:1 | 8.18:1 |
| Link | `link` | `#ff50c8` | 500 | 6.79:1 | 6.45:1 | 4.89:1 |
| URL | `url` | `#66ecd4` | underline | 13.62:1 | 12.94:1 | 9.82:1 |
| Inserted | `inserted` | `#4ce660` | - | 12.01:1 | 11.41:1 | 8.66:1 |
| Deleted | `deleted` | `#5caeff` | - | 8.40:1 | 7.98:1 | 6.06:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#a3c9e9` | background, active line, selection | 8.18:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#62829b` | gutter | 4.56:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#e6d4a3` | background, active line | 12.76:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#5caeff` | background | 8.40:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #59d6ff` | background, active line | 11.14:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#2a6ac080, 1px solid #5caeff` | background (fill or outline) | 8.40:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#032d4a` | active line | 1.32:1 | Pass |
